items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-15
items.q: I was approached by a friend of mine to join this first group that had been organized for about two months, the Salvatio group

ctx.x: I think it was October twenty-nine. Yeah, it was.
Late October. I don't remember it too well myself. But anyway, Salvatio, were you with him when the crash hit or not?

No. No, I went with him after things dwindled down and all that, after that three or four months of working day and night. Then I went with my first group. Then I was approached by a friend of mine to join this first group that had been organized for about two months, the Salvatio group, because they needed a guitar or banjo.
